instruction: Give me a comma-separated list of top 4 most played r&b song titles from across my Spotify song, album and playlist libraries.
notes: Read-only information-gathering task (evaluation requires no database changes), so every action only asserts knowledge predicates. The three Spotify libraries are abstracted by one representative entity each: a song in the song library, an album (with one song) in the album library and a playlist (with one song) in the playlist library; at runtime each listing/show call is iterated over all pages/entries. show_song_library / show_album_library / show_playlist_library discover the ids of library entries (known-id), show_album / show_playlist discover the ids of the songs they contain, and show_song retrieves genre and play_count (song-details-known). The answer object top-4-rb-titles is statically linked (answer-covers) to the candidate songs whose details must be known before it can be computed; supervisor-complete-task takes the answer plus the three distinct covered songs (answer entities) so its precondition equals the problem goal. Supervisor email from show_profile is the Spotify login username; the password comes from show_account_passwords. show_song and show_album need no token; show_playlist is given the token so private playlists in the user's library are readable.
